mentions.name: Anubis
mentions.description: Work on Anubis, a bot-challenge/anti-bot protection tool, making it less aggressive so it only challenges the worst bad bots. The update adds a sample rule (bot/lies-browser-but-http-1.1) that detects bots claiming to be browsers while using HTTP/1.1 — a pattern bots can't fake client side — already deployed on the author's website, where it has issued thousands of challenges.
mentions.problem: Anubis was too aggressive, challenging more traffic than necessary, while bad bots fake browser-like client-side signals (e.g., claiming a browser user agent over HTTP/1.1).
mentions.audience: Anti-bot tooling for website operators; this update targets sites protected by Anubis.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on making Anubis way less aggressive so that it only challenges the worst of the bad bots. I found a pattern that the bots can't fake client side and I've turned that into a sample rule that I've deployed to my website.
